issue.title: accounts: switching to or forgetting a Claude account while Claude Code runs on its folder removes the folder under it
issue.body:
Found while implementing #992 (commit https://github.com/jstar0/magpie/commit/6644747e, `magpie accounts run claude <account>`, which runs the genuine `claude` in a saved account's own folder, `claude-accounts/<hash>`, the same folder the gateway's Claude subscription uses).

## What happens

`switchSavedLogin` (`magpie accounts switch claude <account>`) and `ForgetLogin` wait on `claudeDirRun`, which is a per-process guard. A Claude Code started by another magpie process (or by `magpie accounts run claude`) on that account's folder is not seen by it. So, while such a Claude Code runs:

1. `magpie accounts switch claude <that account>` puts the account's sign-in into Claude Code's own store and removes the folder under the running one. The same refresh token is then held in two places, and whichever refreshes first logs the other out.
2. `magpie accounts forget claude <that account>` removes the folder under the running Claude Code.

## Why it isn't fixed in that change

A cross-process guard (a lock file in the folder, or asking the OS whether a process has `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<folder>`) is a new mechanism. The change documents the gap in `docs/subsystems/providers-accounts.md` and prints a warning on stderr when the command starts, and leaves the guard for this issue.

## Suggested fix

Have `switchSavedLogin` and `ForgetLogin` refuse, with a message naming the running process, when a Claude Code is running on that account's folder: either through a lock held by `accounts run claude` for its lifetime (released when it exits), or by looking for a process with that folder in its environment. A refusal when the state can't be told is safer than going ahead, as elsewhere in the code standards ("a failed read means unknown").

comments.body:
`switchSavedLogin` and `ForgetLogin` waited on `claudeDirRun`, a lock inside one magpie process, and `inSavedClaudeDir` took nothing another magpie could see: while another magpie's Claude Code ran in a saved account's folder, a switch handed that account's sign-in to Claude Code itself and removed the folder under the run (one refresh token in two places), and a removal took the folder away under it.

The branch adds a file lock on the account's folder, held for as long as Claude Code runs in it and taken first by a switch, a sign-in on to the account and a removal of it. A switch or a removal now refuses while another magpie's run holds it, naming the account; nothing is handed over and the folder stays. `addLogin`'s removal of a stale folder keeps one that is in use rather than taking it away under the run. A command that runs the real `claude` in that folder, such as #992's `accounts run claude`, can hold the same lock (`holdClaudeRun`: a lock file under `claude-runs/`, beside `claude-accounts/`) for its run.

[fix/3254-accounts-switching-to-or-forgetting](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3254-accounts-switching-to-or-forgetting), commit 4a73b8d71481e3fa3e2c7c252fab9516eb0f7ece

Run at that commit: `TestClaudeSwitchRefusedWhileAnotherMagpieRunsTheFolder`, `TestClaudeForgetRefusedWhileAnotherMagpieRunsTheFolder`, `TestClaudeSavedRunHoldsItsFolder` and `TestClaudeSignInKeepsAFolderInUse` fail before the change (the switch and the removal go through) and pass after it; `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `go test -tags nogui ./internal/provider` are clean but for `TestCodexAppServersOnHome`, which fails the same way on the base commit without this change.

A fork branch, ready to review; it claims nothing on the issue.

Re-verified at current main (`f53c4a1a1`) — the patch rebased with zero drift (range-diff: 1 commit, identical; nothing upstream touched `internal/provider/logins.go`/`claude_dirs.go` in between), so the patch bytes are unchanged. Full six-element chain, each fresh at this tip:

| Element | Evidence at `f53c4a1a1` |
| --- | --- |
| Rebase | `hunt-20261114-d1-3254` = `f53c4a1a1` + the patch, range-diff identical |
| git am | replays on a clean `upstream/main` to a byte-identical tree |
| Tests | `internal/provider` in full: the only red is the pre-existing `TestResolveVia` (gw.invalid EOF), which fails the same on the base commit without this change; the forget/switch lock family green, `-race` on it ok; `go vet`, `gofmt` clean; `GOOS` linux/darwin/windows `nogui` builds ok |
| Ablation | the `ForgetLogin` guard reverted with the tests kept: `TestClaudeForgetRefusedWhileAnotherMagpieRunsTheFolder/held` fails (`nil`, the forget went through under the run) — restored, green |
| Siblings | `forgetClaudeDir` callers re-scanned at this tip: `forgetLogin` (this patch), the switch hand-over (behind its own wait, `403323af7`), the fresh-sign-in replacement in `signin.go` (rebuilds a directory at once) — unchanged from the patch post |
| Real path | unchanged: the held-lock fixture is the repo's own convention for another process's run (#4532's tests); a real two-process run across two magpie instances stays not verified |

Branch with the commit: [hunt-20261114-d1-3254](https://github.com/ggbdpq/magpie/tree/hunt-20261114-d1-3254) (head `d6f72ab0900d5e98`). The patch is byte-identical to the one posted above — SHA-256 first 16: `b14aeb1bb6b32591` — so `git am` from either post lands the same tree.

Attribution: AI-written; I've read the whole diff and can answer questions on it myself. Please keep the author (`ggbdpq`) or add `Co-authored-by: ggbdpq <ggbdpq@gmail.com>`.

Landed in v0.1.4130 as 284b22172, @ggbdpq's patch unchanged with authorship kept. Before it removes anything, `ForgetLogin` for Claude now takes the account's run mutex and waits on the account directory's run marks (#4532). Past `claudeRunWait` it refuses with `errClaudeRunning`, so the directory and the saved sign-in stay.

Run: `TestClaudeForgetRefusedWhileAnotherMagpieRunsTheFolder` is ok with the change. With `logins.go` reverted to main it is red (`got <nil>`, the forget went through under the run). The full suite (go test -tags nogui -timeout 45m ./..., 99 packages ok) ran on this batch before the last rebase; agent, provider and davsync ran again at the pushed tree.

Left: a fresh sign-in replacing an older saved directory (`signin.go`) still removes it without looking at the marks. That is filed as #6602. @skygunner's switch-side half of this report was covered by #4532's run marks. Leaving this open for @jstar0 to confirm.

issue.title: [feat] Claude Code / Codex：按已保存账号 / 模型启动独立实例（多开，含 Codex App）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## 功能请求

希望能**同时**运行多个 Claude Code、多个 Codex（CLI 和 Codex App 都要），每个实例绑定一个已保存的账号，或者绑定 magpie 里的某个模型 / provider，实例之间互不影响。

目前（v0.1.1079）的情况：

- `magpie accounts switch claude|codex <account>` 都是全局切换。切完之后所有新开的会话都用新账号；Codex 还要重启后台的 `codex app-server daemon`，正在跑的会话会被中断。
- 对 Codex，magpie 只认一个目录：`$CODEX_HOME`，没设置就用 `~/.codex`。
- 想让账号 A 跑一个项目、账号 B 同时跑另一个项目，就只能来回切。

## 现有基础

- **Claude Code**：`internal/provider/claude_dirs.go` 已经给每个已保存的 Claude 账号维护了独立的 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`（`claude-accounts/<hash>`），Claude Code 会在里面自己刷新登录。现在这些目录只给网关的订阅桥接用。
- **终端**：会话页已经能在用户选的终端应用里打开 / 继续一个会话（`internal/gui/terminal_apps.go`）。
- **Codex 会话归属**：`internal/sessions/codex_provider.go` 已经能读写 Codex 会话所属的 provider。

## 本地观察（macOS）

已经有其他工具实现了 Codex 多开，实测可用：

- **Codex CLI 实例**：每个实例一个独立目录作为 `CODEX_HOME`，里面放各自的 `auth.json` 和 `config.toml`。
- **Codex App 实例**：用 `open -n -a ChatGPT.app` 新开一个进程，环境变量里带上 `CODEX_HOME=<实例目录>` 和 `CODEX_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_PATH=<实例自己的 Electron 数据目录>`。这样几个 App 窗口可以同时运行，各自是不同的登录和 provider，互相不影响，也不影响默认的 App。
- 每个实例的会话保存在各自的 `CODEX_HOME/sessions` 和 `state_<n>.sqlite` 里。所以还需要一个办法，让各个实例的会话能互相看到、在任意一个实例里继续。

## 期望行为

**入口**

- 账号页的每个 Claude / Codex 账号加一个「启动实例」按钮：
  - Claude Code 选择工作目录，在终端里启动；
  - Codex 可以选 CLI（在终端里）或 App。
- 也可以把实例保存起来（名字 + 绑定的账号或模型 + 工作目录 + 额外参数），以后一键启动。
- 对应的 CLI，命令名请作者决定，例如：
  ```sh
  magpie accounts run claude <account> [--cwd <dir>] [-- <claude 参数…>]
  magpie accounts run codex <account> [--app] [--cwd <dir>] [-- <codex 参数…>]
  magpie instance add|ls|run|rm …
  ```
- 每个实例的配置目录路径要能查到。这样外部脚本或工具可以往某个实例里部署内容，比如 `AGENTS.md`、hooks。

**绑定对象**

- 可以绑定已保存的订阅账号（Claude / ChatGPT）。
- 也可以绑定 **magpie 里的模型 / 路由组**，经过网关运行，比如 `group/<id>` 或某个中转 provider 的模型。这样一台机器可以同时开「订阅账号 A」「订阅账号 B」「某个中转」好几个实例。
- Codex 实例同样适用「固定 provider id + 保留 ChatGPT 登录」的写法（见 #994，如果那条被采纳的话）。

**哪些独立、哪些共享**

- 独立：登录凭据；Claude 的 `.claude.json` 账号信息；Codex 的 `auth.json`，以及 `config.toml` 里和 provider、模型有关的部分。
- 默认共享主目录里的用户级配置，否则每个实例都要重新配一遍。共享方式（软链接或同步）由作者决定：
  - Claude：`settings.json`（`env` 里和认证有关的字段除外）、`CLAUDE.md`、`skills/`、`agents/`、`commands/`、插件、MCP。
  - Codex：`AGENTS.md`、`config.toml` 里的 `[mcp_servers]`、`[projects]`、hooks、skills、插件。
- 会话按实例分开存放，但：
  - magpie 的会话页要能列出所有实例的会话，点「继续」时回到它所属的那个实例里；
  - 能把某个会话同步或移动到另一个实例，在那里继续。

**并发**

- 实例和默认的全局 Claude Code / Codex 可以同时运行。
- 全局 `accounts switch`、Codex daemon 的重启，都不能影响已经在运行的实例。
- 同一个账号目录既被实例使用、又被网关订阅桥接使用时，两边不能互相干扰（例如刷新 token 时冲突）。

## 验收标准

1. 用 Claude 账号 A、B 各启动一个 Claude Code，两个实例里 `/status` 看到的是各自的账号，并且可以同时运行。
2. 用两个 ChatGPT 账号各启动一个 Codex App，两个窗口能同时运行，各自显示自己的账号；默认的 ChatGPT.app 不受影响。
3. 启动实例前后，全局的 `magpie accounts` 当前账号不变；直接运行 `claude` / `codex` 仍然用全局账号。
4. 全局执行一次 `accounts switch codex`，已经在运行的 Codex 实例不会被中断，也不会被换账号。
5. 在主目录里新增一个 skill 或 MCP，所有实例都能用。
6. 实例里产生的会话出现在 magpie 会话页；点「继续」能回到正确的实例；能把某个会话移到另一个实例继续。
7. 绑定 magpie 模型的实例经过网关运行，用量页能看到它的请求，并能看出来自哪个实例。

issue.title: accounts: removing a saved Claude account doesn't wait for runs in its folder

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body: Sibling of #4532 item 2, left alone by 403323af7 (v0.1.2574). A switch now waits up to 90s for the per-folder run lock files (/usage, warm-up, keep-alive) and fails if one is still going; removing a saved Claude account deletes the folder without taking or waiting on that lock, so a run in progress can lose its folder mid-run (or recreate it after removal). Fix: removal takes the same lock as a switch (inSavedClaudeDir's lock file), waits the same 90s, and fails leaving the account in place if a run still holds it. Also relevant to #992 (accounts run claude).

issue.title: claude: a fresh sign-in removes a saved account's directory under another process's run (#3254 sibling)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
Left by #3254's fix (ggbdpq's patch, landing with this batch): `ForgetLogin` for Claude now waits on the account directory's run marks (#4532's `waitClaudeRuns`) before it removes the directory, and refuses with `errClaudeRunning` past `claudeRunWait`.

`forgetClaudeDir`'s other caller that removes a saved directory, a fresh sign-in replacing an older saved directory in `internal/provider/signin.go`, still removes it without looking at those marks, so another magpie process's run in that directory (a /usage, a warm-up, a keep-alive) can have it taken from under it.

Fix: take `claudeDirRun(user)` and `waitClaudeRuns(user)` there too (or keep the directory in use and write beside it); a test with a held `.run-PID-SEQ.lock` mark, as `TestClaudeForgetRefusedWhileAnotherMagpieRunsTheFolder` does.
